title: Head of Risk (VP Risk)
summary: A head of risk (often titled VP or Director of Risk) leads the risk team in an NBFC, fintech, bank business unit or insurer. They own credit policy and portfolio monitoring, oversee operational and fraud risk, meet RBI rules and present to the risk management committee. In smaller firms they are the senior-most risk person below the CEO.
dailyDuties: Review portfolio quality, delinquency and early warning signals
Approve credit policy changes and scorecard cut-offs
Oversee operational and fraud risk reviews
Prepare risk packs for the risk management committee
Handle RBI inspections and risk returns

skills.expectation: Run the risk framework and risk appetite under the CRO or board
Track portfolio quality, delinquency and early warning signals
Own scorecards and credit policy rules with the model team
Oversee RCSA, loss events and KRIs
Meet RBI scale-based regulation and risk rules
Sign off risk returns and inspection responses
Present to the risk management committee
Lead credit, operational and fraud risk managers
Challenge and support business and collections heads
Oversee treasury and market risk where relevant
Bring in cyber and technology risk views

certifications.why: Useful where the role also covers technology risk.
